title: unified-rollouts: improve canary/A-B/shadow autorollback workflow and observability
author: Brian Cho
description: Context: Recent production incidents showed the existing autorollback engine could be delayed when shadow traffic probes and A/B experiments run concurrently. Motivation: Reduce incident surface and improve rollback timeliness while retaining flexibility for multi-stage canary + shadow flows. Summary: - Refactor autorollback decision engine to introduce a 'quarantine' intermediate state that isolates a rollout when composite metrics cross quorum thresholds instead of immediately reverting; - Add priority-weighted metric aggregation so shadow probes and A/B cohorts can be gated independently; - Introduce per-rollout probe scheduling to avoid probe storms that caused transient false positives; - Add observability: rollout-level composite metrics, diagnostic traces for rollback decisions, and new dashboard panels; - Add E2E and integration tests (canary+shadow+A/B) and stability guards to prevent noisy signals from triggering premature rollbacks. Checklist: - [x] Unit tests for decision engine - [x] Integration tests for scheduling/quarantine - [x] E2E test scenarios for canary + shadow + A/B - [x] Updated docs and release notes - [x] Experimentation flagged behind feature flag (rollouts.quarantine_enabled) Testing and CI: Ran full test matrix; initial e2e run failed due to a race in probe scheduler and was re-run after a fix. Load test shows rollback reaction time reduced median by ~45% for mixed workloads. Backwards compatibility: Changes are behind feature flag and default behavior unchanged. Rollout plan: feature-flag rollout over two weeks, monitor 'rollout.autorollback.decisions' and 'rollout.quarantine.count' metrics, rollback the flag if unexpected regressions. Related: ENG-4821, ENG-4902.

release_notes: Improve autorollback safety and reaction time for mixed canary/A-B/shadow rollouts by adding a quarantine state, priority-weighted metric aggregation, probe scheduling fixes, and new observability. Feature gated behind rollouts.quarantine_enabled.
